reads: Only development assets for schema/claim presence and label audit. Do not download or inspect reserved test records before candidate/adaptation freeze.
integrity: Fixed HTTPS commit URL, exact sizes and Git blob SHA1; record local SHA256 follow-up anchors. These hashes are not publisher signatures.
label_contract: Publisher defines boolean should_sample=true as attack and false as benign. Validate attack_name coherence. Missing/nonboolean/conflicting labels stay unknown; do not insert labels into source records.
input_exclusions: raw account/principal/role/resource/IP identifiers as memorization features
claims: mfaAuthenticated=false is not failed MFA. Session issuer role is not resource-owner authorization policy. Missing identity-active/device-managed/device-health/business-approval fields stay unknown.
scope: Publisher-controlled AWS workload/attack executions captured as CloudTrail logs. Not our AWS deployment or live trusted enterprise signals.
license_status: No explicit LICENSE/COPYING/TERMS path and repository API license=null at pinned commit. Read-only public research inspection only; product adoption/redistribution not selected.
